node.statement: Corollary 5.1 (Theorem 1.4 — GPS moments for pure state): Specialize Lemma 5.5 to psi_sym = |psi><psi|^{tensor n}. Then (psi_sym)_{1,2} = |psi><psi|^{tensor 2} = sigma^2, (psi_sym)_1 = |psi><psi| = sigma. This gives E[sigma_hat_v tensor sigma_hat_v] = ((n-1)/n)sigma^2 + (1/n)(sigma tensor I + I tensor sigma)SWAP + (1/n^2)SWAP - Lower_sigma, where Lower_sigma in SoS(d), proving Theorem 1.4.
